name: The Ritz-Carlton, Los Angeles
positioning: Luxury hotel with rooms on the upper floors at L.A. LIVE in downtown Los Angeles, with a rooftop pool and Latin American dining on the 24th floor
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from Crypto.com Arena and the GRAMMY Museum
Guests who want rooftop pool and skyline views from a downtown base

facts.text: The hotel is located at L.A. LIVE, the sports and entertainment district in downtown Los Angeles.
The hotel is just steps from Crypto.com Arena, Peacock Theater and the GRAMMY Museum.
All accommodations are on the upper floors, with views of the downtown skyline and surrounding hills.
Sendero is a Latin American restaurant on the hotel's 24th floor, inspired by the Pan American highway.
Leña at Sendero is a Latin-inspired steakhouse with a menu of cuts of beef and traditional Latin American dishes.
The Agave Library is an intimate room with city views that offers a tasting menu centered around agave-based spirits.
The rooftop pool and sun deck are on the 26th floor, with panoramic views of the Los Angeles skyline and surrounding Hollywood Hills.
The spa has private relaxation areas, steam rooms, cold plunge showers, a hair and nail salon, a couple's suite and a spa boutique.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The Club Lounge is on the 23rd floor and offers five daily food presentations and panoramic views of downtown Los Angeles.

highlights.text: In the lobby, hand-painted, gilded wallpaper shows a scene originally created for designer Jeanne Lanvin's 1920s Parisian home.
The rooftop pool is on the 26th floor, with panoramic views of the Los Angeles skyline and surrounding Hollywood Hills.
Volante is a chef's counter with eight seats around a crescent counter facing a show kitchen.
A dinner for two on the 50-yard line at SoFi Stadium is offered as a private experience.
Etched mirror headboards emulating Lalique glass artwork are in every guestroom.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Valet parking is available at the hotel for a daily fee of $71.50.
Access to the Club Lounge requires a Club Level booking and is not complimentary for Marriott Bonvoy members.
